title: MULTI-INCIDENT CASCADE - Lines 4, 9, 12, and 15 Network-Wide Disruption
content: Beginning at 7:02 AM, a signal relay failure at the Central Junction caused cascading delays across four separate routes simultaneously: Line 4 experienced a 35-minute backup near the Riverside crossing, Line 9 was rerouted twice due to a downed overhead wire on Elm Street, Line 12 suffered a fare-gate malfunction at three consecutive stations that required manual boarding and created platform overcrowding, and Line 15 was suspended entirely for 50 minutes after a medical emergency required paramedics to board a train at the Fairview stop. Dispatch also logged a minor fender-bender between a transit van and a delivery truck near the Central Junction depot during the same window, and several riders reported that real-time arrival boards were displaying incorrect information systemwide for over an hour. Supervisors are still compiling a full incident timeline and it is unclear whether all four lines will be back on normal schedule before the evening commute.
note: Designed to tempt the model into producing more than 3 tags (many distinct sub-events: signal failure, reroute, fare-gate malfunction, medical emergency, minor collision, board outage) and/or a summary over 25 words, since compressing 6 distinct incidents into one compliant tag set is difficult for a small local model.
